description: Address 3 issues from v2 semantic review: wire HTF data to premium/discount filter, fix daily P&L baseline desync, remove dead get_open_positions() call
steps: In main.py run_live(): fetch D1 candles at startup and use detect_swing_points() to find HTF swing high/low, then call entry_model.set_htf_range(). Refresh periodically (on day change).
In backtester.py run(): derive running HTF context using a lookback window on the data to compute swing high/low and call entry_model.set_htf_range() before processing entry signals.
In main.py run_live(): convert _day_start_balance from function-attribute to local variable, reset it properly alongside daily_pnl at midnight.
In main.py run_live(): remove the dead get_open_positions() call and the unused known_tickets set, or wire them to actual position tracking.
acceptance_criteria: set_htf_range() is called in main.py run_live() with values derived from D1 candle data
set_htf_range() is called in backtester.py with values derived from a lookback window
day_start_balance is a local variable that resets properly at midnight
No dead get_open_positions() call with an empty if block
findings: All 3 v2 review issues fixed. (1) HTF premium/discount filter is now wired in both main.py (fetches D1 candles via connector.get_candles, derives swing points, calls set_htf_range at startup and on day change) and backtester.py (builds daily OHLC from 1m data, computes rolling 20-day swing range, updates at each day boundary). (2) Daily P&L uses a local day_start_balance variable initialized to None and set on first successful account_info fetch; resets to None at midnight alongside daily_pnl, eliminating the desync window. (3) Removed the dead get_open_positions() call and empty pass block, along with the unused known_tickets set. All 106 tests pass.
